Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Shashi Kant Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.

This writ petition, inter alia, has been filed for the following relief:
"1. To issue a writ or certiorari quashing the impugned order dated 21.03.2020 passed by respondent no. 2, Food Safety Officer, Bareilly (Under the Food Safety and Standard Act 2006), whereby the retain license of meat and meat products and poultry has been cancelled in arbitrary manner which was issued in favour of the petitioner on 05.02.2020 be set aside and quashed and the petitioner license be restored forthwith, in the interest of justice."
Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

sentences.text: By order dated 5.10.2020, the learned Standing Counsel was granted time to seek instructions in the matter but till date instruction has not been received.
The main contention of the learned counsel for the petitioner is that the impugned order terminating his license has been passed without giving any opportunity of hearing to the petitioner.
Sri B.P. Singh Kachhawah, learned Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of the State has rebutted the contention made by the learned counsel for the petitioner.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, as the impugned order has been passed in violation of the principles of natural justice i.e. without affording an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner, we hereby set aside the order dated 21.03.2020 passed by the respondent No. 2, Food Safety Officer, Bareilly.
However, it is open to authority concerned to pass fresh order after giving an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner in accordance with law.
